flows.name: T01-外观-原句闭环-接受-刷新-撤销

steps.eval: (() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled); for (const sel of sels.reverse()) { const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) continue; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } return false; })()

steps.text: 把"昨日能耗总览"的文字调大，右对齐，圆角调小一点

steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan]').innerText; return t.includes('字号') && t.includes(' PX') && t.includes('右对齐'); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="region_total_energy"]'); if (!el) return ''; return (el.style.fontSize || '') + '|' + (el.style.textAlign || ''); })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan] select'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="region_total_energy"]'); if (!el) return false; const base = parseFloat(String(styleBefore).split('|')[0]) || 0; const now = parseFloat(el.style.fontSize) || 0; return now > base; })()

(() => { const card = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="region_total_energy"] .wp-card'); return !!card && card.getAttribute('data-wp-font-size') === '1' && card.getAttribute('data-wp-text-align') === '1' && card.getAttribute('data-wp-border-radius') === '1'; })()

(() => { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).map(el => el.dataset.regionId); return els.includes('region_device_ranking') && els.includes('region_hourly_trend'); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="region_total_energy"]'); if (!el) return false; const card = el.querySelector('.wp-card'); return /\d+(\.\d+)?px/.test(el.style.fontSize) && el.style.textAlign === 'right' && !!card && card.getAttribute('data-wp-font-size') === '1'; })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-wp-history]'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.value === 'undo'); if (!opt || opt.disabled) return false; sel.value = 'undo'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="region_total_energy"]'); if (!el) return false; const parts = String(styleBefore).split('|'); return el.style.fontSize === parts[0] && el.style.textAlign === parts[1]; })()
